in_hebrew.name: Boris
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Bringer of glory
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Boris הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Bulgarian and Russian name Borisevich, meaning 'man of Boril' or 'man of glory'. Boris was the name of several early Christian rulers and saints, including Boris I of Bulgaria and Boris of Veliky Novgorod.

in_greek.name: Boris
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Bringer of glory
in_greek.long_meaning: Boris είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Bulgarian and Russian name Borisevich, meaning 'man of Boril' or 'man of glory'. Boris was the name of several early Christian rulers and saints, including Boris I of Bulgaria and Boris of Veliky Novgorod.

in_latin.name: Boris
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Bringer of glory
in_latin.long_meaning: Boris est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Bulgarian and Russian name Borisevich, meaning 'man of Boril' or 'man of glory'.
